About Me

I design experiences across exhibitions, digital banking, and AI

I started out designing interactive displays for museums and commercial spaces, working with screens, physical models, and the spaces around them.

I later moved into digital banking, working on spending insights and a conversational AI feature for exploring transaction data. My work has included user flows, interface design, prototyping, and preparing designs for development.

Working across exhibitions and digital products has shaped how I approach design. I consider what people need to understand, how they move through an experience, and how the interface fits its setting.
